title: Pair each name with its score
move: Walk two lists side by side

content.text: Given a list of names and a list of scores, pair the name at each place with the score at the same place.

examples.spoken: ann and bo with 3 and 5 give ann 3, bo 5

content.text: When one list is longer, its extra items stay unpaired.
